subject: Evaluation kickoff — dataset, scoring, and execution plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + quick asks (evaluation scope)

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the time earlier — helpful call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can start the model-fit run on Redwood:

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use: assist clinicians with coding suggestions and short clinical summaries from visit notes.
- Priority metrics: clinical accuracy (precision on ICD mappings), hallucination rate (false assertions), and latency under 250ms p50.
- Data constraints: PHI redaction required before sending to hosted environments; customer would prefer Private deployment if needed for PII-sensitive fields.

Proposed evaluation plan (high-level)
1) You send a 1k-row sample (de-identified preferred) using the attached template.
2) We run 3 candidate model configs: rwx-7b-v2 (FP16), redwood-13b-q4 (best-efficiency quant profile), and a smaller baseline (rwx-3b).
3) Scoring: canonical label match for coding (70% weight), answer correctness (20%), and brevity/format (10%). We'll provide scorer scripts and an initial prompt bank.

Actions / asks for MedForge
- Please attach a sample CSV using the redwood-eval-template.csv (headers: case_id, note_text, gold_coding, redaction_mask).
- Confirm if PII will be redacted on your side or if you want Redwood Private onboarding.
- Share any existing scoring rubrics or edge-case examples you care about.

I attached the template and a short checklist. Once we have the sample, Ben will propose an exact eval job spec and timeline (target: 3 business days to run baseline).

Related artifacts
- Console eval workspace (we'll create): https://console.redwood.ai/projects/medforge/evals/1234
- Example benchmark we referenced: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cmedforge-eval-assets

Thanks — Ill coordinate the kickoff once we have the sample.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-eval-template.csv (csv, 4KB)]

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medforge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Park <jill.park@medforge.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick asks (evaluation scope)

Vanessa — thanks, this is clear and aligns with our internal view. A couple of clarifications before we send the sample: 

1) Dataset: attaching a de-identified 1,000-row extract (medforge_sample_1000.csv). We've replaced direct identifiers but left clinically relevant tokens (dates shifted +/- 30 days). Let us know if you need a de-identification statement for SOC2.
2) Scoring weights: the 70/20/10 split looks fine; can you confirm how you compute the ICD match (exact vs. hierarchical similarity)? We have legacy mappings we want to preserve.
3) Private vs Hosted: we'd prefer Redwood Private for the final run, but can you run the initial benchmark on hosted sandbox if we remove all PII? That will speed things up.

Attached: medforge_sample_1000.csv (1,000 rows), sample_annotation_guide.pdf

Thanks — Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Data Science | MedForge
[Attachment: medforge_sample_1000.csv (csv, 1.2MB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@medforge.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick asks (evaluation scope)

Thanks Samir — this is perfect. I pulled the sample and sketched an execution plan below; copying the key commands youll see in the eval job so you can validate.

Plan & specifics- Input format: CSV with columns case_id, note_text, gold_coding (pipe-delimited if multiple), redaction_mask (optional). We used your sample and validated parsing.
- ICD match: default is exact top-3 match; we can optionally run a hierarchical similarity scorer (Levenshtein + ontology overlap) as a secondary column. If you want legacy mapping, send mapping.csv and we'll incorporate as a post-processing step.
- Runner configs:
  * Job A: rwx-7b-v2 (FP16), batch_size=8, max_tokens=256
  * Job B: redwood-13b-q4, batch_size=4, max_tokens=256 (quant profile: q4_0)
  * Job C: rwx-3b (baseline)
- Scoring pipeline:
  * coder_match (70%): top-3 exact match on gold_coding
  * correctness (20%): masked token-level check against annotated answers (we will provide a scorer that accepts your sample_annotation_guide.pdf)
  * format (10%): regex-based check for required structure (e.g., ICD: code; summary: <= 150 chars)

Estimated timeline- Baseline runs (Jobs A-C): ~48 hours once we have the final dataset in the console.- Detailed scoring + report: +1 business day after runs.

Security notes
- We can run the initial evaluation in hosted sandbox if you confirm the data is de-identified. For Private onboarding, I'll loop in Solutions Engineering and our Compliance lead and well map the SOC2 evidence required (we support KMS/HSM and audit logs).

Next steps (for MedForge)
1) Confirm de-identification and share mapping.csv if you want legacy code mapping.
2) Approve running the initial jobs on hosted sandbox (faster) or request Private kickoff.
3) Book a 30-min kickoff if you'd like a walkthrough of the scoring UI (Ive included a proposed slot at the link below).

Kickoff booking: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/redwood-eval-kickoff
Console job template: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/medforge/evals/1234/template

[Attachment: medforge-eval-instructions.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
